title: Optimizing Network Resilience Using Domain-Specific Hardware Accelerator for Dynamic Programming
problem: Network routing under failures is computationally expensive; GPU/CPU solutions lack specialized hardware
motivation: Dynamic programming kernels in networking; DPA can accelerate recovery and fault tolerance
method: Custom Dynamic Programming Accelerator (DPA) for optimal routing; comparison vs GPU/CPU solutions
key_novelty: Domain-specific hardware for dynamic programming; application to network resilience
contributions: DPA design for dynamic programming operations
